question.problem:
Given that the random variable $X$ has the probability density function

$$
f(x)=\frac{{e}^{-|x|}}{2},\,x\in (-\infty ,\infty ),
$$

its cumulative distribution function is

$$
F(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{{e}^{x}}{2},\, & x\le 0 \\ h(x),\, & x>0\end{aligned}
$$

where $h(x)=${{field-1}}.
